I love your composition illustrations! I would love to request a work from you! 

Lori, 🍰: 23 years old, 166 cm. Blonde hair on top, dark underneath. Beauty mark under left eye. Impish and a bit bratty, often misbehaving around 🍎. Can be a bit gloomy but masks it with a mischievous persona. Views herself as the moon. Cat coded.  Loves fashion, cute things, and bittersweet flavors. 
Caleb, 🍎: 26 years old, 188 cm. Always wears his necklace. Purple iris’s with orange hues on the bottom. Only cares about 🍰’s approval and often spoils her. Very dependable, often spoiling 🍰. Commonly viewed as the sun. Dog coded.  He likes to give Lori “control” of him when they’re together. Loves sour flavors, learning new skills, flying, and Lori. 

I would love for the work to be romantic and cozy. Maybe 🍎 teasing 🍰 while they are relaxing at home or 🍎 looking at 🍰 with adoration. Please have the background a warm home, maybe with blurred photos in the back. Thank you for considering🙇🏼‍♀️ 💝

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1bla34aQ3LWWAj6rjtrOVMTDDWEwlLXYj

Hi! I love your 呪術廻戦 art. They are very cinematic and I enjoy it very much. I would like to request for a drawing of two original characters. They are both women, and they are in university studying together. They are not together yet, but there is romantic tension. 

I would like something like the reference picture — a simple day at the cafe with a close pose. 

Eden is a wolf character. Very cool vibes and looks cold. But she softens for her romantic interest. She is one head taller than Vali. Eden acts as the "guy" in the relationship. 

Vali is a deer character. Soft, and timid. For this artwork, I would like her with human legs! Please ignore the deer legs and the flowers in the reference picture. She keeps her braid, ears and antlers. 

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1ndSoEA2p0nTl2VgGbi8kHBjILJliPrpT

Hello! I think that your work is simply amazing, and I love the detailed backgrounds and settings you create. I would like to request a drawing of my friend's character if possible. 

The character is a young woman who is the protagonist of a made up horror game. In the game she fights monsters on the beach with her axe. Despite having to fight monsters and seeming moody, she is playful and likes to joke around when you get to know her better.

> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-uA5qdMslhFEhy9XS9y6-PCKRA5ZWDLN

You may draw her as you like, but I would like to ask that you draw her on the surface of the "Strength" tarot card. The card usually has the character with a lion, but would you be able to draw her with an oarfish instead?

Thank you very much for your consideration.

Dr. Nasubon, excuse me.

I would like to ask you to draw an illustration of two of my favorite characters without text.
*I would like to see a scene where they are wearing T-shirts and looking at each other with intimate eyes as if they are a couple.
Character 1] is wearing a white T-shirt and [Character 2] is wearing a black T-shirt. The background depicts a sunrise and a city spread out below them (the scene is of the two sitting on a raised platform where they can enjoy the view).
If possible, please draw their faces clearly.
Please draw them as "good-looking-oji" type characters.

If not enough, please raise the price.

Setting drawing of character 1:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1R9kuaX5LO0_XfCyg7O_AprgIYfnf0chM

Setting diagram for character 2:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SAKQ1ZBzru35FHLfy2aETQpyLLTRALqr

▷⒈The two characters do not wear hats, glasses, goggles, or scarves. Please pay special attention to this point.
They do not look tired or exaggerated.


▷⒉Character 1 has a tattoo on his left arm, please use the right part of this image as a reference for your drawing.
mordeo.org/wallpapers/maverick-tom-clancys-rainbow-six-siege/
Please note that the tattoo resembles a map of Afghanistan.


▷3. Character 2's hand is bandaged.
Character 2's arm has a burn, so please draw that carefully.

▷4. They are both mature in age, approximately 35 years old.
Note that they are both the same height.

▷5. Character 1's personality: intelligent, wise, a good listener, and pursues freedom while keeping his emotions to himself.
Character 2's personality: kind, loyal, and patient.

I am truly sorry for the complexity of my request.
Please forgive me.
Thank you for your consideration.

▶Usage:
Personal viewing
Personal use: SNS icons and headers, PC wallpaper, etc.

https://www.mordeo.org/wallpapers/maverick-tom-clancys-rainbow-six-siege/

Hello!

Thank you for the wonderful illustration last time. I have it printed for my home. I adore it.
Which is why I want to ask you for another artwork of [Risotto Nero] and [Cappuccino]. 
For character details please check last request.

I have two ideas and you can pick the one you prefer: 

A:
[Risotto Nero] and [Cappuccino] are having a date in the streets of Italy. A romantic interaction between them. For example they are seeking shelter from the weather or they enjoy a fancy dinner together. 

B:
They are resting at the hitman team base at the couch (there are pictures how the base looks in the reference folder) and [Cappuccino] is sitting between his legs or on his lap. They are having an intimate romantic moment.

I would be happy if you could keep their very large height difference in mind. I would appreciate if you draw both of their faces so that you can see both of their eyes. Eyes also opened.

I always enjoy moody and dynamic looking, story telling art. 

Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-A7BYIsRbqNhiC5wwOY5Vr7aJ__JFEfQ

Hello,

Sav again. Your last illustration was so wonderful. The more it was so great, the more I wanted to lee quest again.

Recently I was into an anime called Banana Fish.

Could you please draw an illustration of Eiji and Ash in your own way?

Background: A rural Japanese place. I like winter, spring and autumn scenery. My favorite places are Shonan, Chichibu, Yamaguchi, Oita, Yamagata, and Hokkaido. Eiji is from Izumo City in Shimane Prefecture, so I would like the scenery of Izumo City or a rural area.

Ash would like to see Eiji and I living together in Japan, so that's why I made this request.

Pose: I would like to see them doing seasonal activities or relaxing somewhere (house, park, amusement park, etc.)

Also, can you please make the illustration in 9x16 size? We will use it for our Kobo screen saver.

Thank you very much.

Your couple art is absolutely gorgeous. I'd like to request art of these 2

https://imgur.com/a/8RrR60Y

For personal use only

Lillie is 21. She's grown more confident in herself over the years but it's also made her a more prideful. While she takes work seriously, there's nothing more she loves more than to spend time with her boyfriend, Hau.

Hau is 22. Despite being an adult he's still carefree and takes nothing to seriously. He's taken over his Grandpa's position and wears his robe over his own favorite T-shirt. The only thing he loves more than his Friends and Malasadas is his girlfriend, Lillie.

Hau is slightly muscular and has defined abs but is still skinny. Lillie ponytail is very long and she has a curvy body. She's only slightly shorter than Hau. 

I want an illustration of them on a casual date with the setting of your choosing. They could be walking down together on a city block or eating at a restaurant or watching a movie on the couch. Whichever you choose. Thank you!

If there is anything inappropriate about my request, feel free to apply for an adjustment. If you are not interested in my OCs, feel free to cancel directly.

He’s an outgoing and clever guy who can be quite defiant and reckless. He’s 186 cm tall. Brown hair, dark green eyes. Lean and athletic build. Second character is Matvei. He is an intelligent and stoic introvert who is incredibly loyal to those he cares about. He’s 180 cm tall and of average build. Black hair and dark brown, almost black eyes. 
Benjamin and Matvei have been friends since childhood and are really close. They frequently hang out with each other in the city they live in. Matvei doesn't know that Benjamin is a vampire and while Benjamin wants to tell him, he knows it’s best to keep it a secret.
You are free to draw both boys as you see fit, I will leave poses and expressions to you and your interpretation of them. 

Thank you so much for your consideration!

はじめまして、KIRIsame.RWと申します。
なすぼんさまの描かれる男性の色気が素晴らしく、ぜひOCカップル（男×男）のイラストをリクエストしたいです…！

【使用用途】
■個人鑑賞用
■SNSや個人サイトにご依頼で描いて頂いたイラストとして掲載
┗都度クレジット表記し、無断転載防止措置を施します
■商用利用等の予定なし

■キャラクター①：ノエ・ガルア（36歳／攻）
┗クールなエリート社長
┗“他者に不幸をもたらす守護天使”の宿主という忌諱される境遇にあり、心を閉ざして育った
┗基本やり手の仕事人だが世慣れた色気もある。ヘビースモーカー
┗恋愛を暇潰しや遊びと考える冷淡な面があるが、レーベレヒトとの出逢いで変わっていく
┗元々ゲイでタチ。恋人や親しい相手にだけ愛情深い一面を見せることも
┗イメージ：死神、蛇、煙草、夜、埋葬など

■キャラクター②：レーベレヒト・ヘルムス（32歳／受）
┗等身大マッチョ営業マン
┗そこそこ良い家柄で愛されて育ったため若干自信家。根は純粋でお人好し
┗意外に繊細な面があり、どこか憎めない愛嬌がある。猫飼い
┗霊が見える体質で、ノエが人ならざるなにかを宿していることを知っている
┗元々は女性が恋愛対象だったが、影があり孤高に感じるノエに惹かれていく
┗イメージ：空、猫、飛行機、夜明け、など

資料を元に、服装・ポーズ等々、基本的にはなすぼんさまのイメージにお任せしますが、もし宜しければ大人の恋人同士といった場面や、少し色っぽい感じの雰囲気で描いて頂けると嬉しいです。
（もちろんどのような雰囲気でも歓迎します！思い浮かんだイメージで描いて頂けると幸いです）
もし不都合等ありましたら、遠慮なくキャンセルや再送要請してくださいませ。

お忙しいところ恐縮ですが、ご検討だけでも宜しくお願い致します！*ᴗ ᴗ)⁾⁾

DIAはメロディより少し背が高い。怠け者だけど、いざというときは頼りになるかっこいいお姉さんという雰囲気。彼女は思慮深く、行動を起こす前に綿密な計画を立てることを好む。DIAはハンドガンと、爪や大砲などの武器に変形できる腕を使って戦います。趣味は探偵小説。彼女は甘いペストリーとブラックコーヒーが好きだ。ふっくらとした大きな胸と柔らかそうな体。

Melodyはちょっとおてんば娘。とても自信家で、どんな状況にもすぐに適応できる。とても頼りになるが、気が短い。Melodyが使うのは、大きなレンチと剣、そして体力だ。彼女は他の道具や即席の武器も適当に使う。趣味は特撮番組と漫画。辛い食べ物と甘いコーヒーが好きだ。控えめなバスト、むっちりとした太もも、ぷりっとしたキュートなお尻を持つMelody。引き締まったボディの持ち主だ。

先生の呪術廻戦のファンアートは本当にいい！カジュアルな雰囲気が素晴らしい。レストランでの食事やバスの待ち時間など、日常的なシチュエーションで娘たちを見てみたい。

ご自由に描いてください。先生にとってかっこいいシーンであればうれしいです。

ご検討よろしくお願いします。

Hello! Nice to meet you!

I really enjoy your artwork and so I would like to request art of my vampire character. He’s an outgoing, clever and reckless guy who sometimes gets himself into trouble because of his reckless nature. He's good at fighting his way out of it though. He enjoys skateboarding, urban exploring and seeking thrills.
